The '''Grand Moff Bank''' was a Novice level [[Bank (swoopchasing)|Bank]] fence used in [[swoopchasing]]. Built at an angle between thirty-five to forty-five degrees, [[swoopchaser]]s had to accelerate into the Grand Moff Bank to crest the top of the Bank. Usually, Grand Moff Banks had a [[Repulsor-Out]] at the apex, increasing the difficulty of the climb as the fence attempted to repel the rider and their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]. [[Repulsor-In]] fences were usually placed on the backside of the Grand Moff Bank to draw the rider in. At Outlaw level, the Repulsor-In fence was replaced with a [[Gravity Well (swoopchasing)|Gravity Well]].<ref name="BSS" />
